author: Pavlo
body:
This is my contest map, Tropic Waters!

Gamemode: FFA (Free For All)
Creator: Pavlo

There will be at least five spawn locations, one on every outer island. Each island has a bridge to the middle where everyone meets. If you fall off the islands or bridges, you land on a layer of glass so you can still pvp.

Loadout:
- Iron sword
- Bow
- 3 Gapples
- 16 steak
- 32 arrows
